name: Rosetta Reverie
description: Three slender portrait ribbons, a feathered latte-art flourish and a large flowing title above a generous reading column.

name: Cocoa Cadence
description: Offset horizontal photographs, cocoa crosshatching and an angular double-rule frame with a quiet typeset story.

name: Silken Pour
description: A long teardrop portrait beside a sweeping title, with milk-pour curves carrying the composition into the writing.

name: Marbled Hours
description: A literary page with topographic milk-and-cocoa contours, an oversized italic heading and an off-centre name tab.

name: Velvet Ratio
description: Three staggered portrait panels over fine vertical pour-lines, a compact centre title and a layered colour hem.

name: Foamline
description: A softly squared smartphone with a petal contact portrait, rosetta speaker mark and rounded incoming bubbles.

name: Cocoa Circuit
description: A landscape pocket messenger with ribbed grips, a small status display and crisp inset message cards.

name: Milkglass Messenger
description: A group-chat smartphone with three tall contact tiles, a translucent member-colour bezel and a clean message screen.

name: Pourcast
description: An angular handset with a narrow side speaker rail, a corner portrait and a strong vertical conversation stripe.

name: Melt Mode
description: A rounded smartwatch messenger with twin contact tiles, a ridged band, a side crown and miniature message bubbles.

name: Foamlet
description: A little scalloped latte-art card with a slanted title and a thin three-colour baseline.

name: Cocoa Flicker
description: A small angular note with a clipped corner photograph, cocoa crosshatching and an inset signature line.

name: Milktrace
description: A compact asymmetrical drop with a curved colour edge, delicate heading and a tiny reply.

name: Three Sugars
description: A miniature three-portrait strip above one shared name, a fine title rule and a short reply.

name: Last Swirl
description: An open horizontal note with a small marbled swirl at the margin and a member-coloured undercurrent.
